projects.title: Fair Lease AI
projects.description: Multimodal AI that detects property damage by diffing move-in and move-out photos with Bedrock Nova Vision, then estimates repair costs through a real-time RAG pipeline.
projects.longDescription: Designed and deployed a multimodal AI application that uses Amazon Bedrock Nova Vision to automate property damage detection via image diffing across 100+ inspection categories, replacing manual inspection workflows and reducing assessment time from hours to seconds per property. Built a RAG pipeline integrating Tavily AI for real-time repair cost estimation grounded in current market data, cutting estimation turnaround by over 70%. The entire serverless backend (Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway and S3) is provisioned with Terraform, with a CI/CD pipeline for one-command, repeatable deploys.

projects.title: DistressNet: Vocal Distress Detection
projects.description: A CNN on log-mel spectrograms that scores vocal distress, combined with an LLM read of the transcript and a judge that adjudicates the two signals.
projects.longDescription: Trained DistressNet, a compact convolutional network on log-mel spectrograms, to separate distressed from calm speech using the RAVDESS and CREMA-D emotional-speech corpora with actor-disjoint train/test splits and class weighting. The FastAPI backend pairs the voice score with a language analysis of the transcript (rule-based, with an optional LLM via OpenAI or Ollama), and a judge module adjudicates both signals with explicit crisis-language handling. A React + Vite studio lets users record a clip, inspect the result and ask a built-in assistant how the model works, framed carefully as a defined class, not a diagnosis.

projects.title: AI Agent for Ticket Triage & Auto-Assignment
projects.description: Multi-agent CrewAI system with 5+ specialised roles that automates bug classification and assignment, cutting average triage time by 60%.
projects.longDescription: Architected a multi-agent system using CrewAI with 5+ specialised agent roles (including triage analyst, priority ranker and developer matcher) to automate bug classification and assignment end-to-end. Assignment weighs severity, priority, estimated hours and developer expertise. Reduced average ticket triage time by 60%, cutting sprint-planning overhead, and built Streamlit dashboards that surface live ticket-queue metrics for data-driven sprint planning and workload visibility. Containerised with Docker.

projects.title: University Q&A Platform
projects.description: Real-time AI Q&A platform for university questions that grounds LLM answers in online sources and prior community discussions.
projects.longDescription: Built a real-time, AI-powered Q&A platform where answers are generated by grounding LLM responses in online sources and prior community discussions, handling 200+ university-specific queries with sub-second response times. Designed the retrieval and ranking pipeline to prioritise contextually relevant prior answers, improving response quality and reducing duplicate question volume by 35%. Self-hosted the Supabase backend with Docker, with role-based auth and real-time subscriptions.

projects.title: DocGuard & CareerMatch
projects.description: Full-stack SaaS for sentence-level AI-generated-text detection and ATS résumé scoring, built on a transformer ensemble and FastAPI.
projects.longDescription: Team project. DocGuard gives a sentence-by-sentence breakdown of AI-generated versus human-written text using a multi-model ensemble (RoBERTa plus a ChatGPT detector with Platt calibration) and linguistic features such as perplexity, burstiness and vocabulary richness. CareerMatch scores a résumé against a job description using sentence-embedding similarity, keyword-gap analysis and ATS-parsability checks, then returns prioritised recommendations. Built with FastAPI, Next.js 14, PostgreSQL, Redis, Stripe billing, Clerk auth, an MCP server, and Docker Compose behind Nginx with GitHub Actions CI/CD.

projects.title: Mindgarden
projects.description: AI creative-ideation canvas built for the IBM AI Builders Challenge. Four AI personas pitch directions and ideas grow, remix and crystallise on an infinite canvas.
projects.longDescription: Built for the IBM AI Builders Challenge (Creative Industries theme). A user's one-line seed idea goes to a 'creative council' of four AI personas (Purist, Architect, Disruptor and Strategist), and a Creative Director AI recommends the best fit against the user's stated priorities. The chosen concept lives on an infinite React Flow canvas where nodes can grow into new branches, be remixed into hybrids, and be crystallised into a full concept package (synopsis, characters, visual style, sample scene) exportable as HTML. A provider-abstraction layer swaps between a production-quality demo mode and real LLMs such as IBM watsonx Granite.

projects.title: Tax Invoice Reader
projects.description: Created an AI-based tool to extract and process tax invoice data using AWS Bedrock and Pinecone.
projects.longDescription: Developed a machine learning solution to automate tax invoice processing. The model extracted key fields from scanned invoices, leveraging AWS Bedrock for deployment and Pinecone for vectorized storage and retrieval. This reduced manual data entry effort by 60% and streamlined business operations for invoice handling.

projects.title: Research Agent
projects.description: Multi-agent research pipeline that pulls papers from arXiv, summarises them with a transformer model and reviews their credibility.
projects.longDescription: A multi-agent research assistant: a researcher agent fetches papers from arXiv for a topic, a summariser agent condenses abstracts with a Hugging Face BART summarisation model, a reviewer agent assesses credibility, and a data-analyst agent produces a structured JSON research report. Includes an AutoGen-based coordinator for orchestrating the agents conversationally.

projects.title: AI News Intelligence Dashboard
projects.description: Agentic pipeline that fetches the latest AI, DevOps and cybersecurity news, summarises each article and scores its sentiment on a live dashboard.
projects.longDescription: A set of cooperating agents (fetcher, summariser and sentiment analyser) wired together with LangChain tools. The pipeline pulls the latest English-language news on AI, tech, DevOps, cybersecurity and AI agents from NewsAPI, summarises each article and classifies its sentiment with Hugging Face models, and logs agent decisions. A Streamlit dashboard with Plotly charts surfaces summaries, sentiment distribution and topic trends.

projects.title: Jira Webhook AI Agent
projects.description: Hackathon agent that reacts to new Jira issues: it clones the repo, runs the build and tests, and summarises the result with an LLM.
projects.longDescription: Team hackathon project. A Flask webhook listener receives Jira 'issue created' events, fetches the issue via the Jira API, and hands it to a planner agent that clones or pulls the linked repository, runs the build and test suite, and returns a JSON summary. An AI agent then uses OpenAI models to summarise failures and suggest next steps, closing the loop from ticket to diagnosis automatically.

projects.title: CareLoop
projects.description: Care-coordination app where patients and caregivers upload medical records and get AI-generated summaries, appointments and alerts in one place.
projects.longDescription: A full-stack care-coordination platform with separate patient and caregiver views. Users upload prescriptions, diagnoses and reports (with text extraction from files), and each record receives an AI-generated summary. Patients, appointments, prescription uploads and alerts are modelled in Prisma on MySQL, with a Next.js App Router front end and API routes.

projects.title: Voice Authenticity Detection
projects.description: Machine-learning study that classifies genuine versus synthetic speech from audio features, comparing classical models with a CNN.
projects.longDescription: Explored detecting spoofed or synthetic voices with machine learning. Extracted audio features with librosa and compared classical classifiers (Random Forest, SVM) against a Keras CNN, evaluating with classification reports, confusion matrices and ROC-AUC. Presented the approach and findings as a class research presentation.

projects.title: Genetic Predisposition of Lesion Using Machine Learning
projects.description: Developed CNN and ANN models to classify cancerous lesions, improving detection accuracy from 75% to 83%.
projects.longDescription: Designed and implemented deep learning models (CNN and ANN) to classify various types of cancerous lesions using a dataset of 10,000 medical images. Applied preprocessing and data augmentation to improve robustness, followed by extensive hyperparameter tuning to optimize performance. The project demonstrated the potential of AI-assisted medical diagnostics in improving early detection and accuracy.

projects.title: Dermatitis Stratification and Cancer Prognostication with Diet Pyramid
projects.description: Built a multi-class ML model to classify skin conditions and integrated a diet pyramid for personalized nutrition recommendations.
projects.longDescription: Developed an automated dermatological diagnostic system capable of classifying skin conditions as cancerous, non-cancerous, or pre-cancerous. Implemented multi-class classification using Logistic Regression and Random Forest, achieving 82.5% accuracy. Evaluation was conducted with accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. Additionally, integrated a custom-built diet pyramid to provide tailored nutritional advice, enhancing the system's practical utility for preventive healthcare.

projects.title: Diet Meal Plan Chatbot
projects.description: Developed a cloud-based conversational AI chatbot that generates personalized meal plans based on user dietary habits and health goals.
projects.longDescription: Built a conversational AI chatbot to provide real-time dietary recommendations and personalized meal plans. Designed natural language understanding (NLU) using AWS Lex and implemented backend logic with AWS Lambda for processing user inputs and generating meal recommendations. The system was deployed on AWS, ensuring scalability and reliability, and successfully handled multiple concurrent users seeking nutrition guidance.

projects.title: Election Commission Web Application
projects.description: Built a real-time election results app for Karnataka using React.js, Redux, Jenkins, and Terraform on AWS.
projects.longDescription: Developed a full-stack web application displaying real-time Karnataka election results. Built front-end interfaces in React.js with state management using Redux, and integrated CI/CD pipelines via Jenkins for automated deployment. Managed cloud infrastructure and security with Terraform on AWS, ensuring scalability, high availability, and security during peak traffic.

projects.title: Agriculture Dashboard Application
projects.description: Designed a cloud-native dashboard for real-time agricultural analytics using Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform on AWS.
projects.longDescription: Developed a scalable web-based dashboard that provided real-time monitoring and visualization for agricultural data. Designed intuitive interfaces with interactive charts, containerized the app using Docker, orchestrated deployment with Kubernetes, and provisioned infrastructure using Terraform on AWS. The platform enabled large-scale data processing and improved decision-making for crop and field-level management.

projects.title: Email Phishing Analysis
projects.description: Implemented phishing detection by automating email analysis with Splunk and VirusTotal API.
projects.longDescription: Built a cybersecurity solution for analyzing and detecting potential phishing threats. Automated parsing of email headers and content using Splunk and integrated VirusTotal API for real-time threat intelligence. The system enhanced the organization's detection and incident response capabilities, reducing risks from phishing attempts.

projects.title: Website Performance & SEO Checker
projects.description: Developed an AI-powered tool to analyze website performance metrics and generate SEO recommendations.
projects.longDescription: Built an AI-driven web performance and SEO analyzer that captured key site metrics such as load time, responsiveness, and content ranking signals. Integrated AWS Bedrock to generate automated SEO recommendations. Delivered an end-to-end monitoring system that provided actionable insights to improve website visibility and performance.
